descriptionHtml:
Kickstart your entry into PC gaming with the Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9! Equipped with an Intel Core i5 HX-series processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 graphics, and a fast 144Hz Full HD display, this laptop delivers solid performance for modern games, everyday multitasking, and creative projects.
